description: Change the COLOURS of an existing logo without redesigning it: the symbol's shape, the wordmark and the lockups stay exactly as they are; only the colours change. Instant, free, and no AI involved. Either give `replace` — {old: new} hex swaps, e.g. {"#ff5500": "#0a7d4f"} changes just that colour — or a whole new `palette` in the logo's slot order (most dominant first; at most as many colours as the logo was made with). Get the current colours from sketchxflow_list_logos. Pass `project_id` when a design shows this logo, so its copies switch to the new colours too. The previous colours are kept as one step of history in the logo page's Revert. For a genuinely new logo, use sketchxflow_create_logo instead.

logo_id.description: The logo's id (from sketchxflow_list_logos or sketchxflow_create_logo).

palette.description: A whole new set of #RRGGBB colours in slot order (most dominant first). Use this OR replace.

project_id.description: A design that shows this logo — its logo images move to the new colours.

replace.description: Colour swaps, {"#old": "#new"}, applied to the logo's current colours. Colours not named stay.

name: sketchxflow_recolor_logo
title: Change a logo's colours
